title: SvgFeComposite
responsibility: Renders the native feComposite element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: SvgFeComposite.children
inputs.description: Optional Svelte snippet content rendered inside the native feComposite element when truthy. The implementation does not validate or transform the snippet; when omitted or falsy, it renders no child content.

outputs.name: SvgFeComposite
outputs.description: The rendered native SVG feComposite element, with every property other than children spread onto it and the children snippet rendered when truthy. The component adds no wrapper or additional feature behavior.
